title: Mueon Raises $65M for AI Server Racks With 10x Capacity
summary:
Maverick Silicon led a new investment round for the Portland-based creator of high-density server components for artificial intelligence. Mueon raised $65 million in Series A funding, with participation from Intel Capital, to scale its proprietary Cubelets 3D compute and memory architecture which it claims can fit up to 10x more computing capacity within a standard rack.

The company is now moving the Cubelets design toward system validation and production. The architecture aims to deliver 10x power and cost efficiency by optimizing the density of compute and memory within the physical footprint of the data center rack.
